notes.title: TRAFFIC v1.07 Final Patch
notes.content:
Alright guys, this is officially the last patch for this game (unless something really bad happens or until the VR Edition starts being developed)

Here are the super important changes:
[list]
[*] Performance optimization, max fps set to 60 to avoid unlimited framerate issues.
[*] Added light switch tip so players realize there are light switches in the house they can switch on.
[*] Made the Halloween Event a little bit easier since it was still pretty tough.
[*] Made the pumpkin in the main menu fly away because it's not Halloween anymore but he's still a pretty cool guy.
[*] Added a link to a trailer for my new game, 'I REMEMBER' on the Main Menu.
[/list]
And that's all. Please go Wishlist my new game 'I REMEMBER', it's already on Steam and will be releasing in March. 

Or click here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317170/I_REMEMBER/]'I REMEMBER' Steam Page[/url]

Thanks!

notes.title: TRAFFIC v1.06
notes.content:
[Main Game]
[list]
[*] Fixed really weird collision bug that let players escape the house and find the BIG CUBA FAMILY Easter egg. Now you have to work for it.
[*] Fixed a couple missing sound effects in the final day.
[/list]

[Halloween Event]
[list]
[*] Added New ACHIEVEMENT.
[*] Added much needed and much deserved credits.
[*] Nerfed the ability to fly around with the basketball while still allowing players to cross shadow demons up.
[*] Removed weirdly placed purple portal from ending cutscene that covered up the cool thing behind it.
[/list]
